slug: 2021-08-04 Health information systems in developing countries case of African countries

facts.fact: A literature review of 12 African countries' health information systems, carried out February to July 2019, found Malawi the only one of the 12 with a national strategy for its health information system to which all actors, donors included, must align, accompanied by a procedural guide; the other 11 ran on project strategies.
facts.system: national health information system (DHIS-based data warehouse)

systems.system: national health information system (DHIS-based data warehouse)

note: Regional review; the only Malawi-specific statement is the national strategy. The review covers literature from 2005 to 2019 and its Malawi sources are older than the review.
